input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position on every material term: Services must be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1); Deliverables conform to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after delivery or acceptance, and Hosted Services conform for the whole subscription term (19.2), which exceeds the 12-month/90-day benchmark; Vendor warrants no malicious code and compliance with Applicable Law (19.3); and 19.4 gives re-performance, repair or replacement, with termination and refund of Fees paid if Vendor cannot cure, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the warranty. No redline needed.
